bsb.90:10: The length of our days is seventy years— or eighty if we are strong— yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for they quickly pass, and we fly away.
bsb.90:11: Who knows the power of Your anger? Your wrath matches the fear You are due.
bsb.90:12: So teach us to number our days, that we may present a heart of wisdom.
bsb.90:13: Return, O LORD! How long will it be? Have compassion on Your servants.
bsb.90:14: Satisfy us in the morning with Your loving devotion, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.
bsb.90:15: Make us glad for as many days as You have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.
bsb.90:16: May Your work be shown to Your servants, and Your splendor to their children.
bsb.90:17: May the favor of the Lord our God rest upon us; establish for us the work of our hands— yes, establish the work of our hands!
bsb.91:1: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
bsb.91:2: I will say to the LORD, “You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”
bsb.91:3: Surely He will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly plague.
bsb.91:4: He will cover you with His feathers; under His wings you will find refuge; His faithfulness is a shield and rampart.
bsb.91:5: You will not fear the terror of the night, nor the arrow that flies by day,
bsb.91:6: nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness, nor the calamity that destroys at noon.
bsb.91:7: Though a thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand, no harm will come near you.
bsb.91:8: You will only see it with your eyes and witness the punishment of the wicked.
bsb.91:9: Because you have made the LORD your dwelling— my refuge, the Most High—
bsb.91:10: no evil will befall you, no plague will approach your tent.
bsb.91:11: For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.
bsb.91:12: They will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.
bsb.91:13: You will tread on the lion and cobra; you will trample the young lion and serpent.
bsb.91:14: “Because he loves Me, I will deliver him; because he knows My name, I will protect him.
bsb.91:15: When he calls out to Me, I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him and honor him.
bsb.91:16: With long life I will satisfy him and show him My salvation.”
bsb.92:1: A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day. It is good to praise the LORD, and to sing praises to Your name, O Most High,
bsb.92:2: to proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning and Your faithfulness at night
bsb.92:3: with the ten-stringed harp and the melody of the lyre.
bsb.92:4: For You, O LORD, have made me glad by Your deeds; I sing for joy at the works of Your hands.
bsb.92:5: How great are Your works, O LORD, how deep are Your thoughts!
bsb.92:6: A senseless man does not know, and a fool does not understand,
bsb.92:7: that though the wicked sprout like grass, and all evildoers flourish, they will be forever destroyed.
bsb.92:8: But You, O LORD, are exalted forever!
bsb.92:9: For surely Your enemies, O LORD, surely Your enemies will perish; all evildoers will be scattered.
bsb.92:10: But You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox; with fine oil I have been anointed.
bsb.92:11: My eyes see the downfall of my enemies; my ears hear the wailing of my wicked foes.
bsb.92:12: The righteous will flourish like a palm tree, and grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
bsb.92:13: Planted in the house of the LORD, they will flourish in the courts of our God.
bsb.92:14: In old age they will still bear fruit; healthy and green they will remain,
bsb.92:15: to proclaim, “The LORD is upright; He is my Rock, and in Him there is no unrighteousness.”
bsb.93:1: The LORD reigns! He is robed in majesty; the LORD has clothed and armed Himself with strength. The world indeed is firmly established; it cannot be moved.
bsb.93:2: Your throne was established long ago; You are from all eternity.
bsb.93:3: The floodwaters have risen, O LORD; the rivers have raised their voice; the seas lift up their pounding waves.
bsb.93:4: Above the roar of many waters— the mighty breakers of the sea— the LORD on high is majestic.
bsb.93:5: Your testimonies are fully confirmed; holiness adorns Your house, O LORD, for all the days to come.
bsb.94:1: O LORD, God of vengeance, O God of vengeance, shine forth.
bsb.94:2: Rise up, O Judge of the earth; render a reward to the proud.
bsb.94:3: How long will the wicked, O LORD, how long will the wicked exult?
bsb.94:4: They pour out arrogant words; all workers of iniquity boast.
bsb.94:5: They crush Your people, O LORD; they oppress Your heritage.
bsb.94:6: They kill the widow and the foreigner; they murder the fatherless.
bsb.94:7: They say, “The LORD does not see; the God of Jacob pays no heed.”
bsb.94:8: Take notice, O senseless among the people! O fools, when will you be wise?
bsb.94:9: He who affixed the ear, can He not hear? He who formed the eye, can He not see?
bsb.94:10: He who admonishes the nations, does He not discipline? He who teaches man, does He lack knowledge?
bsb.94:11: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.
bsb.94:12: Blessed is the man You discipline, O LORD, and teach from Your law,
bsb.94:13: to grant him relief from days of trouble, until a pit is dug for the wicked.
bsb.94:14: For the LORD will not forsake His people; He will never abandon His heritage.
bsb.94:15: Surely judgment will again be righteous, and all the upright in heart will follow it.
bsb.94:16: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand for me against the workers of iniquity?
bsb.94:17: Unless the LORD had been my helper, I would soon have dwelt in the abode of silence.
bsb.94:18: If I say, “My foot is slipping,” Your loving devotion, O LORD, supports me.
bsb.94:19: When anxiety overwhelms me, Your consolation delights my soul.
bsb.94:20: Can a corrupt throne be Your ally— one devising mischief by decree?
bsb.94:21: They band together against the righteous and condemn the innocent to death.
bsb.94:22: But the LORD has been my stronghold, and my God is my rock of refuge.
bsb.94:23: He will bring upon them their own iniquity and destroy them for their wickedness. The LORD our God will destroy them.
bsb.95:1: Come, let us sing for joy to the LORD; let us shout to the Rock of our salvation!
bsb.95:2: Let us enter His presence with thanksgiving; let us make a joyful noise to Him in song.
bsb.95:3: For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.
bsb.95:4: In His hand are the depths of the earth, and the mountain peaks belong to Him.
bsb.95:5: The sea is His, for He made it, and His hands formed the dry land.
bsb.95:6: O come, let us worship and bow down; let us kneel before the LORD our Maker.
bsb.95:7: For He is our God, and we are the people of His pasture, the sheep under His care. Today, if you hear His voice,
bsb.95:8: do not harden your hearts as you did at Meribah, in the day at Massah in the wilderness,
bsb.95:9: where your fathers tested and tried Me, though they had seen My work.
bsb.95:10: For forty years I was angry with that generation, and I said, “They are a people whose hearts go astray, and they have not known My ways.”
bsb.95:11: So I swore on oath in My anger, “They shall never enter My rest.”
bsb.96:1: Sing to the LORD a new song; sing to the LORD, all the earth.
bsb.96:2: Sing to the LORD, bless His name; proclaim His salvation day after day.
bsb.96:3: Declare His glory among the nations, His wonderful deeds among all peoples.
bsb.96:4: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.
bsb.96:5: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but it is the LORD who made the heavens.
bsb.96:6: Splendor and majesty are before Him; strength and beauty fill His sanctuary.
bsb.96:7: Ascribe to the LORD, O families of the nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
bsb.96:8: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; bring an offering and enter His courts.
bsb.96:9: Worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness; tremble before Him, all the earth.
bsb.96:10: Declare among the nations: “The LORD reigns!” The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved; He will judge the peoples with equity.
bsb.96:11: Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice; let the sea resound, and all that fills it.
bsb.96:12: Let the fields exult, and all that is in them. Then all the trees of the forest will sing for joy
bsb.96:13: before the LORD, for He is coming— He is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in His faithfulness.
bsb.97:1: The LORD reigns, let the earth rejoice; let the distant shores be glad.
bsb.97:2: Clouds and darkness surround Him; righteousness and justice are His throne’s foundation.
bsb.97:3: Fire goes before Him and consumes His foes on every side.
bsb.97:4: His lightning illuminates the world; the earth sees and trembles.
bsb.97:5: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, before the Lord of all the earth.
bsb.97:6: The heavens proclaim His righteousness; all the peoples see His glory.
bsb.97:7: All worshipers of images are put to shame— those who boast in idols. Worship Him, all you gods!
bsb.97:8: Zion hears and rejoices, and the towns of Judah exult because of Your judgments, O LORD.
bsb.97:9: For You, O LORD, are Most High over all the earth; You are exalted far above all gods.
bsb.97:10: Hate evil, O you who love the LORD! He preserves the souls of His saints; He delivers them from the hand of the wicked.
bsb.97:11: Light shines on the righteous, gladness on the upright in heart.
bsb.97:12: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous ones, and praise His holy name.
bsb.98:1: A Psalm. Sing to the LORD a new song, for He has done wonders; His right hand and holy arm have gained Him the victory.
bsb.98:2: The LORD has proclaimed His salvation and revealed His righteousness to the nations.
bsb.98:3: He has remembered His love and faithfulness to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
bsb.98:4: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth; break forth—let your cry ring out, and sing praises!
bsb.98:5: Sing praises to the LORD with the lyre, in melodious song with the harp.
bsb.98:6: With trumpets and the blast of the ram’s horn shout for joy before the LORD, the King.
bsb.98:7: Let the sea resound, and all that fills it, the world, and all who dwell in it.
bsb.98:8: Let the rivers clap their hands, let the mountains sing together for joy
bsb.98:9: before the LORD, for He comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with equity.
bsb.99:1: The LORD reigns; let the nations tremble! He is enthroned above the cherubim; let the earth quake!
bsb.99:2: Great is the LORD in Zion; He is exalted above all the peoples.
bsb.99:3: Let them praise Your great and awesome name— He is holy!
bsb.99:4: The mighty King loves justice. You have established equity; You have exercised justice and righteousness in Jacob.
bsb.99:5: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at His footstool; He is holy!
bsb.99:6: Moses and Aaron were among His priests; Samuel was among those who called on His name. They called to the LORD and He answered.
bsb.99:7: He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept His decrees and the statutes He gave them.
bsb.99:8: O LORD our God, You answered them. You were a forgiving God to them, yet an avenger of their misdeeds.
bsb.99:9: Exalt the LORD our God and worship at His holy mountain, for the LORD our God is holy.
bsb.100:1: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth.
bsb.100:2: Serve the LORD with gladness; come into His presence with joyful songs.
bsb.100:3: Know that the LORD is God. It is He who made us, and we are His; we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture.
bsb.100:4: Enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise; give thanks to Him and bless His name.
bsb.100:5: For the LORD is good, and His loving devotion endures forever; His faithfulness continues to all generations.
bsb.101:1: A Psalm of David. I will sing of Your loving devotion and justice; to You, O LORD, I will sing praises.
bsb.101:2: I will ponder the way that is blameless— when will You come to me? I will walk in my house with integrity of heart.
bsb.101:3: I will set no worthless thing before my eyes. I hate the work of those who fall away; it shall not cling to me.
bsb.101:4: A perverse heart shall depart from me; I will know nothing of evil.
bsb.101:5: Whoever slanders his neighbor in secret, I will put to silence; the one with haughty eyes and a proud heart, I will not endure.
bsb.101:6: My eyes favor the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me; he who walks in the way of integrity shall minister to me.
bsb.101:7: No one who practices deceit shall dwell in my house; no one who tells lies shall stand in my presence.
bsb.101:8: Every morning I will remove all the wicked of the land, that I may cut off every evildoer from the city of the LORD.
bsb.102:1: A prayer of one who is afflicted, when he grows faint and pours out his lament before the LORD. Hear my prayer, O LORD; let my cry for help come before You.
bsb.102:2: Do not hide Your face from me in my day of distress. Incline Your ear to me; answer me quickly when I call.
bsb.102:3: For my days vanish like smoke, and my bones burn like glowing embers.
bsb.102:4: My heart is afflicted, and withered like grass; I even forget to eat my bread.
bsb.102:5: Through my loud groaning my flesh clings to my bones.
bsb.102:6: I am like a desert owl, like an owl among the ruins.
bsb.102:7: I lie awake; I am like a lone bird on a housetop.
bsb.102:8: All day long my enemies taunt me; they ridicule me and curse me.
bsb.102:9: For I have eaten ashes like bread and mixed my drink with tears
bsb.102:10: because of Your indignation and wrath, for You have picked me up and cast me aside.
bsb.102:11: My days are like lengthening shadows, and I wither away like grass.
bsb.102:12: But You, O LORD, sit enthroned forever; Your renown endures to all generations.
bsb.102:13: You will rise up and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show her favor— the appointed time has come.
bsb.102:14: For Your servants delight in her stones and take pity on her dust.
bsb.102:15: So the nations will fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth will fear Your glory.
bsb.102:16: For the LORD will rebuild Zion; He has appeared in His glory.
bsb.102:17: He will turn toward the prayer of the destitute; He will not despise their prayer.
bsb.102:18: Let this be written for the generation to come, so that a people not yet created may praise the LORD.
bsb.102:19: For He looked down from the heights of His sanctuary; the LORD gazed out from heaven to earth
bsb.102:20: to hear a prisoner’s groaning, to release those condemned to death,
bsb.102:21: that they may proclaim the name of the LORD in Zion and praise Him in Jerusalem,
bsb.102:22: when peoples and kingdoms assemble to serve the LORD.
bsb.102:23: He has broken my strength on the way; He has cut short my days.
bsb.102:24: I say: “O my God, do not take me in the midst of my days! Your years go on through all generations.
bsb.102:25: In the beginning You laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.
bsb.102:26: They will perish, but You remain; they will all wear out like a garment. Like clothing You will change them, and they will be passed on.
bsb.102:27: But You remain the same, and Your years will never end.
bsb.102:28: The children of Your servants will dwell securely, and their descendants will be established before You.”
bsb.103:1: Of David. Bless the LORD, O my soul; all that is within me, bless His holy name.
bsb.103:2: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and do not forget all His kind deeds—
bsb.103:3: He who forgives all your iniquities and heals all your diseases,
bsb.103:4: who redeems your life from the Pit and crowns you with loving devotion and compassion,
bsb.103:5: who satisfies you with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
bsb.103:6: The LORD executes righteousness and justice for all the oppressed.
bsb.103:7: He made known His ways to Moses, His deeds to the people of Israel.
bsb.103:8: The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion.
bsb.103:9: He will not always accuse us, nor harbor His anger forever.
bsb.103:10: He has not dealt with us according to our sins or repaid us according to our iniquities.
bsb.103:11: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is His loving devotion for those who fear Him.
bsb.103:12: As far as the east is from the west, so far has He removed our transgressions from us.
bsb.103:13: As a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him.
bsb.103:14: For He knows our frame; He is mindful that we are dust.
bsb.103:15: As for man, his days are like grass— he blooms like a flower of the field;
bsb.103:16: when the wind passes over, it vanishes, and its place remembers it no more.
bsb.103:17: But from everlasting to everlasting the loving devotion of the LORD extends to those who fear Him, and His righteousness to their children’s children—
bsb.103:18: to those who keep His covenant and remember to obey His precepts.
bsb.103:19: The LORD has established His throne in heaven, and His kingdom rules over all.
bsb.103:20: Bless the LORD, all His angels mighty in strength who carry out His word, who hearken to the voice of His command.
bsb.103:21: Bless the LORD, all His hosts, you servants who do His will.
bsb.103:22: Bless the LORD, all His works in all places of His dominion. Bless the LORD, O my soul!
bsb.104:1: Bless the LORD, O my soul! O LORD my God, You are very great; You are clothed with splendor and majesty.
bsb.104:2: He wraps Himself in light as with a garment; He stretches out the heavens like a tent,
bsb.104:3: laying the beams of His chambers in the waters above, making the clouds His chariot, walking on the wings of the wind.
bsb.104:4: He makes the winds His messengers, flames of fire His servants.
bsb.104:5: He set the earth on its foundations, never to be moved.
bsb.104:6: You covered it with the deep like a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.
bsb.104:7: At Your rebuke the waters fled; at the sound of Your thunder they hurried away—
bsb.104:8: the mountains rose and the valleys sank to the place You assigned for them—
bsb.104:9: You set a boundary they cannot cross, that they may never again cover the earth.
bsb.104:10: He sends forth springs in the valleys; they flow between the mountains.
bsb.104:11: They give drink to every beast of the field; the wild donkeys quench their thirst.
bsb.104:12: The birds of the air nest beside the springs; they sing among the branches.
bsb.104:13: He waters the mountains from His chambers; the earth is satisfied by the fruit of His works.
bsb.104:14: He makes the grass grow for the livestock and provides crops for man to cultivate, bringing forth food from the earth:
bsb.104:15: wine that gladdens the heart of man, oil that makes his face to shine, and bread that sustains his heart.
bsb.104:16: The trees of the LORD have their fill, the cedars of Lebanon that He planted,
bsb.104:17: where the birds build their nests; the stork makes her home in the cypresses.
bsb.104:18: The high mountains are for the wild goats, the cliffs a refuge for the rock badgers.
bsb.104:19: He made the moon to mark the seasons; the sun knows when to set.
bsb.104:20: You bring darkness, and it becomes night, when all the beasts of the forest prowl.
bsb.104:21: The young lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.
bsb.104:22: The sun rises, and they withdraw; they lie down in their dens.
bsb.104:23: Man goes forth to his work and to his labor until evening.
bsb.104:24: How many are Your works, O LORD! In wisdom You have made them all; the earth is full of Your creatures.
bsb.104:25: Here is the sea, vast and wide, teeming with creatures beyond number, living things both great and small.
bsb.104:26: There the ships pass, and Leviathan, which You formed to frolic there.
bsb.104:27: All creatures look to You to give them their food in due season.
bsb.104:28: When You give it to them, they gather it up; when You open Your hand, they are satisfied with good things.
bsb.104:29: When You hide Your face, they are terrified; when You take away their breath, they die and return to dust.
bsb.104:30: When You send Your Spirit, they are created, and You renew the face of the earth.
bsb.104:31: May the glory of the LORD endure forever; may the LORD rejoice in His works.
bsb.104:32: He looks on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smolder.
bsb.104:33: I will sing to the LORD all my life; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
bsb.104:34: May my meditation be pleasing to Him, for I rejoice in the LORD.
bsb.104:35: May sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, O my soul. Hallelujah!
bsb.105:1: Give thanks to the LORD, call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.
bsb.105:2: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; tell of all His wonders.
bsb.105:3: Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
bsb.105:4: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
bsb.105:5: Remember the wonders He has done, His marvels, and the judgments He has pronounced,
bsb.105:6: O offspring of His servant Abraham, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
bsb.105:7: He is the LORD our God; His judgments carry throughout the earth.
bsb.105:8: He remembers His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations—
bsb.105:9: the covenant He made with Abraham, and the oath He swore to Isaac.
bsb.105:10: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:
bsb.105:11: “I will give you the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance.”
bsb.105:12: When they were few in number, few indeed, and strangers in the land,
bsb.105:13: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.
bsb.105:14: He let no man oppress them; He rebuked kings on their behalf:
bsb.105:15: “Do not touch My anointed ones! Do no harm to My prophets!”
bsb.105:16: He called down famine on the land and cut off all their supplies of food.
bsb.105:17: He sent a man before them— Joseph, sold as a slave.
bsb.105:18: They bruised his feet with shackles and placed his neck in irons,
bsb.105:19: until his prediction came true and the word of the LORD proved him right.
bsb.105:20: The king sent and released him; the ruler of peoples set him free.
bsb.105:21: He made him master of his household, ruler over all his substance,
bsb.105:22: to instruct his princes as he pleased and teach his elders wisdom.
bsb.105:23: Then Israel entered Egypt; Jacob dwelt in the land of Ham.
bsb.105:24: And the LORD made His people very fruitful, more numerous than their foes,
bsb.105:25: whose hearts He turned to hate His people, to conspire against His servants.
bsb.105:26: He sent Moses His servant, and Aaron, whom He had chosen.
bsb.105:27: They performed His miraculous signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
bsb.105:28: He sent darkness, and it became dark— yet they defied His words.
bsb.105:29: He turned their waters to blood and caused their fish to die.
bsb.105:30: Their land teemed with frogs, even in their royal chambers.
bsb.105:31: He spoke, and insects swarmed— gnats throughout their country.
bsb.105:32: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning throughout their land.
bsb.105:33: He struck their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country.
bsb.105:34: He spoke, and the locusts came— young locusts without number.
bsb.105:35: They devoured every plant in their land and consumed the produce of their soil.
bsb.105:36: Then He struck all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their vigor.
bsb.105:37: He brought Israel out with silver and gold, and none among His tribes stumbled.
bsb.105:38: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the dread of Israel had fallen on them.
bsb.105:39: He spread a cloud as a covering and a fire to light up the night.
bsb.105:40: They asked, and He brought quail and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
bsb.105:41: He opened a rock, and water gushed out; it flowed like a river in the desert.
bsb.105:42: For He remembered His holy promise to Abraham His servant.
bsb.105:43: He brought forth His people with rejoicing, His chosen with shouts of joy.
bsb.105:44: He gave them the lands of the nations, that they might inherit the fruit of others’ labor,
bsb.105:45: that they might keep His statutes and obey His laws. Hallelujah!
bsb.106:1: Hallelujah! Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.106:2: Who can describe the mighty acts of the LORD or fully proclaim His praise?
bsb.106:3: Blessed are those who uphold justice, who practice righteousness at all times.
bsb.106:4: Remember me, O LORD, in Your favor to Your people; visit me with Your salvation,
bsb.106:5: that I may see the prosperity of Your chosen ones, and rejoice in the gladness of Your nation, and give glory with Your inheritance.
bsb.106:6: We have sinned like our fathers; we have done wrong and acted wickedly.
bsb.106:7: Our fathers in Egypt did not grasp Your wonders or remember Your abundant kindness; but they rebelled by the sea, there at the Red Sea.
bsb.106:8: Yet He saved them for the sake of His name, to make His power known.
bsb.106:9: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; He led them through the depths as through a desert.
bsb.106:10: He saved them from the hand that hated them; He redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
bsb.106:11: The waters covered their foes; not one of them remained.
bsb.106:12: Then they believed His promises and sang His praise.
bsb.106:13: Yet they soon forgot His works and failed to wait for His counsel.
bsb.106:14: They craved intensely in the wilderness and tested God in the desert.
bsb.106:15: So He granted their request, but sent a wasting disease upon them.
bsb.106:16: In the camp they envied Moses, as well as Aaron, the holy one of the LORD.
bsb.106:17: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan; it covered the assembly of Abiram.
bsb.106:18: Then fire blazed through their company; flames consumed the wicked.
bsb.106:19: At Horeb they made a calf and worshiped a molten image.
bsb.106:20: They exchanged their Glory for the image of a grass-eating ox.
bsb.106:21: They forgot God their Savior, who did great things in Egypt,
bsb.106:22: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome deeds by the Red Sea.
bsb.106:23: So He said He would destroy them— had not Moses His chosen one stood before Him in the breach to divert His wrath from destroying them.
bsb.106:24: They despised the pleasant land; they did not believe His promise.
bsb.106:25: They grumbled in their tents and did not listen to the voice of the LORD.
bsb.106:26: So He raised His hand and swore to cast them down in the wilderness,
bsb.106:27: to disperse their offspring among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.
bsb.106:28: They yoked themselves to Baal of Peor and ate sacrifices offered to lifeless gods.
bsb.106:29: So they provoked the LORD to anger with their deeds, and a plague broke out among them.
bsb.106:30: But Phinehas stood and intervened, and the plague was restrained.
bsb.106:31: It was credited to him as righteousness for endless generations to come.
bsb.106:32: At the waters of Meribah they angered the LORD, and trouble came to Moses because of them.
bsb.106:33: For they rebelled against His Spirit, and Moses spoke rashly with his lips.
bsb.106:34: They did not destroy the peoples as the LORD had commanded them,
bsb.106:35: but they mingled with the nations and adopted their customs.
bsb.106:36: They worshiped their idols, which became a snare to them.
bsb.106:37: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.
bsb.106:38: They shed innocent blood— the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was polluted with blood.
bsb.106:39: They defiled themselves by their actions and prostituted themselves by their deeds.
bsb.106:40: So the anger of the LORD burned against His people, and He abhorred His own inheritance.
bsb.106:41: He delivered them into the hand of the nations, and those who hated them ruled over them.
bsb.106:42: Their enemies oppressed them, and subdued them under their hand.
bsb.106:43: Many times He rescued them, but they were bent on rebellion and sank down in their iniquity.
bsb.106:44: Nevertheless He heard their cry; He took note of their distress.
bsb.106:45: And He remembered His covenant with them, and relented by the abundance of His loving devotion.
bsb.106:46: He made them objects of compassion to all who held them captive.
bsb.106:47: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from the nations, that we may give thanks to Your holy name, that we may glory in Your praise.
bsb.106:48: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Let all the people say, “Amen!” Hallelujah!
bsb.107:1: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.107:2: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom He has redeemed from the hand of the enemy
bsb.107:3: and gathered from the lands, from east and west, from north and south.
bsb.107:4: Some wandered in desert wastelands, finding no path to a city in which to dwell.
bsb.107:5: They were hungry and thirsty; their soul fainted within them.
bsb.107:6: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He delivered them from their distress.
bsb.107:7: He led them on a straight path to reach a city where they could live.
bsb.107:8: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
bsb.107:9: For He satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.
bsb.107:10: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, prisoners in affliction and chains,
bsb.107:11: because they rebelled against the words of God and despised the counsel of the Most High.
bsb.107:12: He humbled their hearts with hard labor; they stumbled, and there was no one to help.
bsb.107:13: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
bsb.107:14: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death and broke away their chains.
bsb.107:15: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
bsb.107:16: For He has broken down the gates of bronze and cut through the bars of iron.
bsb.107:17: Fools, in their rebellious ways, and through their iniquities, suffered affliction.
bsb.107:18: They loathed all food and drew near to the gates of death.
bsb.107:19: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
bsb.107:20: He sent forth His word and healed them; He rescued them from the Pit.
bsb.107:21: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
bsb.107:22: Let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving and declare His works with rejoicing.
bsb.107:23: Others went out to sea in ships, conducting trade on the mighty waters.
bsb.107:24: They saw the works of the LORD, and His wonders in the deep.
bsb.107:25: For He spoke and raised a tempest that lifted the waves of the sea.
bsb.107:26: They mounted up to the heavens, then sunk to the depths; their courage melted in their anguish.
bsb.107:27: They reeled and staggered like drunkards, and all their skill was useless.
bsb.107:28: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He brought them out of their distress.
bsb.107:29: He calmed the storm to a whisper, and the waves of the sea were hushed.
bsb.107:30: They rejoiced in the silence, and He guided them to the harbor they desired.
bsb.107:31: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
bsb.107:32: Let them exalt Him in the assembly of the people and praise Him in the council of the elders.
bsb.107:33: He turns rivers into deserts, springs of water into thirsty ground,
bsb.107:34: and fruitful land into fields of salt, because of the wickedness of its dwellers.
bsb.107:35: He turns a desert into pools of water and a dry land into flowing springs.
bsb.107:36: He causes the hungry to settle there, that they may establish a city in which to dwell.
bsb.107:37: They sow fields and plant vineyards that yield a fruitful harvest.
bsb.107:38: He blesses them, and they multiply greatly; He does not let their herds diminish.
bsb.107:39: When they are decreased and humbled by oppression, evil, and sorrow,
bsb.107:40: He pours out contempt on the nobles and makes them wander in a trackless wasteland.
bsb.107:41: But He lifts the needy from affliction and increases their families like flocks.
bsb.107:42: The upright see and rejoice, and all iniquity shuts its mouth.
bsb.107:43: Let him who is wise pay heed to these things and consider the loving devotion of the LORD.
bsb.108:1: A song. A Psalm of David. My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing and make music with all my being.
bsb.108:2: Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
bsb.108:3: I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing Your praises among the peoples.
bsb.108:4: For Your loving devotion extends beyond the heavens, and Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
bsb.108:5: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
bsb.108:6: Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.
bsb.108:7: God has spoken from His sanctuary: “I will triumph! I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth.
bsb.108:8: Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.
bsb.108:9: Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I toss My sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.”
bsb.108:10: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
bsb.108:11: Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?
bsb.108:12: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.
bsb.108:13: With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.
bsb.109:1: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O God of my praise, be not silent.
bsb.109:2: For wicked and deceitful mouths open against me; they speak against me with lying tongues.
bsb.109:3: They surround me with hateful words and attack me without cause.
bsb.109:4: In return for my love they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.
bsb.109:5: They repay me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
bsb.109:6: Set over him a wicked man; let an accuser stand at his right hand.
bsb.109:7: When he is tried, let him be found guilty, and may his prayer be regarded as sin.
bsb.109:8: May his days be few; may another take his position.
bsb.109:9: May his children be fatherless and his wife a widow.
bsb.109:10: May his children wander as beggars, seeking sustenance far from their ruined homes.
bsb.109:11: May the creditor seize all he owns, and strangers plunder the fruits of his labor.
bsb.109:12: May there be no one to extend kindness to him, and no one to favor his fatherless children.
bsb.109:13: May his descendants be cut off; may their name be blotted out from the next generation.
bsb.109:14: May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the LORD, and the sin of his mother never be blotted out.
bsb.109:15: May their sins always remain before the LORD, that He may cut off their memory from the earth.
bsb.109:16: For he never thought to show kindness, but pursued the poor and needy and brokenhearted, even to their death.
bsb.109:17: The cursing that he loved, may it fall on him; the blessing in which he refused to delight, may it be far from him.
bsb.109:18: The cursing that he wore like a coat, may it soak into his body like water, and into his bones like oil.
bsb.109:19: May it be like a robe wrapped about him, like a belt tied forever around him.
bsb.109:20: May this be the LORD’s reward to my accusers, to those who speak evil against me.
bsb.109:21: But You, O GOD, the Lord, deal kindly with me for the sake of Your name; deliver me by the goodness of Your loving devotion.
bsb.109:22: For I am poor and needy; my heart is wounded within me.
bsb.109:23: I am fading away like a lengthening shadow; I am shaken off like a locust.
bsb.109:24: My knees are weak from fasting, and my body grows lean and gaunt.
bsb.109:25: I am an object of scorn to my accusers; when they see me, they shake their heads.
bsb.109:26: Help me, O LORD my God; save me according to Your loving devotion.
bsb.109:27: Let them know that this is Your hand, that You, O LORD, have done it.
bsb.109:28: Though they curse, You will bless. When they rise up, they will be put to shame, but Your servant will rejoice.
bsb.109:29: May my accusers be clothed with disgrace; may they wear their shame like a robe.
bsb.109:30: With my mouth I will thank the LORD profusely; I will praise Him in the presence of many.
bsb.109:31: For He stands at the right hand of the needy one, to save him from the condemners of his soul.
bsb.110:1: A Psalm of David. The LORD said to my Lord: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”
bsb.110:2: The LORD extends Your mighty scepter from Zion: “Rule in the midst of Your enemies.”
bsb.110:3: Your people shall be willing on Your day of battle. Arrayed in holy splendor, from the womb of the dawn, to You belongs the dew of Your youth.
bsb.110:4: The LORD has sworn and will not change His mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”
bsb.110:5: The Lord is at Your right hand; He will crush kings in the day of His wrath.
bsb.110:6: He will judge the nations, heaping up the dead; He will crush the leaders far and wide.
bsb.110:7: He will drink from the brook by the road; therefore He will lift up His head.
bsb.111:1: Hallelujah! I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.
bsb.111:2: Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.
bsb.111:3: Splendid and majestic is His work; His righteousness endures forever.
bsb.111:4: He has caused His wonders to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.
bsb.111:5: He provides food for those who fear Him; He remembers His covenant forever.
bsb.111:6: He has shown His people the power of His works by giving them the inheritance of the nations.
bsb.111:7: The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His precepts are trustworthy.
bsb.111:8: They are upheld forever and ever, enacted in truth and uprightness.
bsb.111:9: He has sent redemption to His people; He has ordained His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name.
bsb.111:10: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding. His praise endures forever!
bsb.112:1: Hallelujah! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who greatly delights in His commandments.
bsb.112:2: His descendants will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.
bsb.112:3: Wealth and riches are in his house, and his righteousness endures forever.
bsb.112:4: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright— for the gracious, compassionate, and righteous.
bsb.112:5: It is well with the man who is generous and lends freely, whose affairs are guided by justice.
bsb.112:6: Surely he will never be shaken; the righteous man will be remembered forever.
bsb.112:7: He does not fear bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
bsb.112:8: His heart is assured; he does not fear, until he looks in triumph on his foes.
bsb.112:9: He has scattered abroad his gifts to the poor; his righteousness endures forever; his horn will be lifted high in honor.
bsb.112:10: The wicked man will see and be grieved; he will gnash his teeth and waste away; the desires of the wicked will perish.
bsb.113:1: Hallelujah! Give praise, O servants of the LORD; praise the name of the LORD.
bsb.113:2: Blessed be the name of the LORD both now and forevermore.
bsb.113:3: From where the sun rises to where it sets, the name of the LORD is praised.
bsb.113:4: The LORD is exalted over all the nations, His glory above the heavens.
bsb.113:5: Who is like the LORD our God, the One enthroned on high?
bsb.113:6: He humbles Himself to behold the heavens and the earth.
bsb.113:7: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the dump
bsb.113:8: to seat them with nobles, with the princes of His people.
bsb.113:9: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother to her children. Hallelujah!
bsb.114:1: When Israel departed from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign tongue,
bsb.114:2: Judah became God’s sanctuary, and Israel His dominion.
bsb.114:3: The sea observed and fled; the Jordan turned back;
bsb.114:4: the mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs.
bsb.114:5: Why was it, O sea, that you fled, O Jordan, that you turned back,
bsb.114:6: O mountains, that you skipped like rams, O hills, like lambs?
bsb.114:7: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
bsb.114:8: who turned the rock into a pool, the flint into a fountain of water!
bsb.115:1: Not to us, O LORD, not to us, but to Your name be the glory, because of Your loving devotion, because of Your faithfulness.
bsb.115:2: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?”
bsb.115:3: Our God is in heaven; He does as He pleases.
bsb.115:4: Their idols are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.
bsb.115:5: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;
bsb.115:6: they have ears, but cannot hear; they have noses, but cannot smell;
bsb.115:7: they have hands, but cannot feel; they have feet, but cannot walk; they cannot even clear their throats.
bsb.115:8: Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.
bsb.115:9: O Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
bsb.115:10: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
bsb.115:11: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
bsb.115:12: The LORD is mindful of us; He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron;
bsb.115:13: He will bless those who fear the LORD— small and great alike.
bsb.115:14: May the LORD give you increase, both you and your children.
bsb.115:15: May you be blessed by the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
bsb.115:16: The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but the earth He has given to mankind.
bsb.115:17: It is not the dead who praise the LORD, nor any who descend into silence.
bsb.115:18: But it is we who will bless the LORD, both now and forevermore. Hallelujah!
bsb.116:1: I love the LORD, for He has heard my voice— my appeal for mercy.
bsb.116:2: Because He has inclined His ear to me, I will call on Him as long as I live.
bsb.116:3: The ropes of death entangled me; the anguish of Sheol overcame me; I was confronted by trouble and sorrow.
bsb.116:4: Then I called on the name of the LORD: “O LORD, deliver my soul!”
bsb.116:5: The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion.
bsb.116:6: The LORD preserves the simplehearted; I was helpless, and He saved me.
bsb.116:7: Return to your rest, O my soul, for the LORD has been good to you.
bsb.116:8: For You have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
bsb.116:9: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
bsb.116:10: I believed, therefore I said, “I am greatly afflicted.”
bsb.116:11: In my alarm I said, “All men are liars!”
bsb.116:12: How can I repay the LORD for all His goodness to me?
bsb.116:13: I will lift the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD.
bsb.116:14: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people.
bsb.116:15: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of His saints.
bsb.116:16: Truly, O LORD, I am Your servant; I am Your servant, the son of Your maidservant; You have broken my bonds.
bsb.116:17: I will offer to You a sacrifice of thanksgiving and call on the name of the LORD.
bsb.116:18: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people,
bsb.116:19: in the courts of the LORD’s house, in your midst, O Jerusalem. Hallelujah!
bsb.117:1: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol Him, all you peoples!
bsb.117:2: For great is His loving devotion toward us, and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever. Hallelujah!
bsb.118:1: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.118:2: Let Israel say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
bsb.118:3: Let the house of Aaron say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
bsb.118:4: Let those who fear the LORD say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
bsb.118:5: In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered and set me free.
bsb.118:6: The LORD is on my side; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
bsb.118:7: The LORD is on my side; He is my helper. Therefore I will look in triumph on those who hate me.
bsb.118:8: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in man.
bsb.118:9: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in princes.
bsb.118:10: All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
bsb.118:11: They surrounded me on every side, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
bsb.118:12: They swarmed around me like bees, but they were extinguished like burning thorns; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
bsb.118:13: I was pushed so hard I was falling, but the LORD helped me.
bsb.118:14: The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation.
bsb.118:15: Shouts of joy and salvation resound in the tents of the righteous: “The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!
bsb.118:16: The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!”
bsb.118:17: I will not die, but I will live and proclaim what the LORD has done.
bsb.118:18: The LORD disciplined me severely, but He has not given me over to death.
bsb.118:19: Open to me the gates of righteousness, that I may enter and give thanks to the LORD.
bsb.118:20: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous shall enter through it.
bsb.118:21: I will give You thanks, for You have answered me, and You have become my salvation.
bsb.118:22: The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
bsb.118:23: This is from the LORD, and it is marvelous in our eyes.
bsb.118:24: This is the day that the LORD has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
bsb.118:25: O LORD, save us, we pray. We beseech You, O LORD, cause us to prosper!
bsb.118:26: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD. From the house of the LORD we bless you.
bsb.118:27: The LORD is God; He has made His light to shine upon us. Bind the festal sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar.
bsb.118:28: You are my God, and I will give You thanks. You are my God, and I will exalt You.
bsb.118:29: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.119:1: Blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the Law of the LORD.
bsb.119:2: Blessed are those who keep His testimonies and seek Him with all their heart.
bsb.119:3: They do no iniquity; they walk in His ways.
bsb.119:4: You have ordained Your precepts, that we should keep them diligently.
bsb.119:5: Oh, that my ways were committed to keeping Your statutes!
bsb.119:6: Then I would not be ashamed when I consider all Your commandments.
bsb.119:7: I will praise You with an upright heart when I learn Your righteous judgments.
bsb.119:8: I will keep Your statutes; do not utterly forsake me.
bsb.119:9: How can a young man keep his way pure? By guarding it according to Your word.
bsb.119:10: With all my heart I have sought You; do not let me stray from Your commandments.
bsb.119:11: I have hidden Your word in my heart that I might not sin against You.
bsb.119:12: Blessed are You, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.
bsb.119:13: With my lips I proclaim all the judgments of Your mouth.
bsb.119:14: I rejoice in the way of Your testimonies as much as in all riches.
bsb.119:15: I will meditate on Your precepts and regard Your ways.
bsb.119:16: I will delight in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word.
bsb.119:17: Deal bountifully with Your servant, that I may live and keep Your word.
bsb.119:18: Open my eyes that I may see wondrous things from Your law.
bsb.119:19: I am a stranger on the earth; do not hide Your commandments from me.
bsb.119:20: My soul is consumed with longing for Your judgments at all times.
bsb.119:21: You rebuke the arrogant— the cursed who stray from Your commandments.
bsb.119:22: Remove my scorn and contempt, for I have kept Your testimonies.
bsb.119:23: Though rulers sit and slander me, Your servant meditates on Your statutes.
bsb.119:24: Your testimonies are indeed my delight; they are my counselors.
bsb.119:25: My soul cleaves to the dust; revive me according to Your word.
bsb.119:26: I recounted my ways, and You answered me; teach me Your statutes.
bsb.119:27: Make clear to me the way of Your precepts; then I will meditate on Your wonders.
bsb.119:28: My soul melts with sorrow; strengthen me according to Your word.
bsb.119:29: Remove me from the path of deceit and graciously grant me Your law.
bsb.119:30: I have chosen the way of truth; I have set Your ordinances before me.
bsb.119:31: I cling to Your testimonies, O LORD; let me not be put to shame.
bsb.119:32: I run in the path of Your commandments, for You will enlarge my heart.
bsb.119:33: Teach me, O LORD, the way of Your statutes, and I will keep them to the end.
bsb.119:34: Give me understanding that I may obey Your law, and follow it with all my heart.
bsb.119:35: Direct me in the path of Your commandments, for there I find delight.
bsb.119:36: Turn my heart to Your testimonies and not to covetous gain.
bsb.119:37: Turn my eyes away from worthless things; revive me with Your word.
bsb.119:38: Establish Your word to Your servant, to produce reverence for You.
bsb.119:39: Turn away the disgrace I dread, for Your judgments are good.
bsb.119:40: How I long for Your precepts! Revive me in Your righteousness.
bsb.119:41: May Your loving devotion come to me, O LORD, Your salvation, according to Your promise.
bsb.119:42: Then I can answer him who taunts, for I trust in Your word.
bsb.119:43: Never take Your word of truth from my mouth, for I hope in Your judgments.
bsb.119:44: I will always obey Your law, forever and ever.
bsb.119:45: And I will walk in freedom, for I have sought Your precepts.
bsb.119:46: I will speak of Your testimonies before kings, and I will not be ashamed.
bsb.119:47: I delight in Your commandments because I love them.
bsb.119:48: I lift up my hands to Your commandments, which I love, and I meditate on Your statutes.
bsb.119:49: Remember Your word to Your servant, upon which You have given me hope.
bsb.119:50: This is my comfort in affliction, that Your promise has given me life.
bsb.119:51: The arrogant utterly deride me, but I do not turn from Your law.
bsb.119:52: I remember Your judgments of old, O LORD, and in them I find comfort.
bsb.119:53: Rage has taken hold of me because of the wicked who reject Your law.
bsb.119:54: Your statutes are songs to me in the house of my pilgrimage.
bsb.119:55: In the night, O LORD, I remember Your name, that I may keep Your law.
bsb.119:56: This is my practice, for I obey Your precepts.
bsb.119:57: The LORD is my portion; I have promised to keep Your words.
bsb.119:58: I have sought Your face with all my heart; be gracious to me according to Your promise.
bsb.119:59: I considered my ways and turned my steps to Your testimonies.
bsb.119:60: I hurried without hesitating to keep Your commandments.
bsb.119:61: Though the ropes of the wicked bind me, I do not forget Your law.
bsb.119:62: At midnight I rise to give You thanks for Your righteous judgments.
bsb.119:63: I am a friend to all who fear You, and to those who keep Your precepts.
bsb.119:64: The earth is filled with Your loving devotion, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.
bsb.119:65: You are good to Your servant, O LORD, according to Your word.
bsb.119:66: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in Your commandments.
bsb.119:67: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I keep Your word.
bsb.119:68: You are good, and You do what is good; teach me Your statutes.
bsb.119:69: Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies, I keep Your precepts with all my heart.
bsb.119:70: Their hearts are hard and callous, but I delight in Your law.
bsb.119:71: It was good for me to be afflicted, that I might learn Your statutes.
bsb.119:72: The law from Your mouth is more precious to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
bsb.119:73: Your hands have made me and fashioned me; give me understanding to learn Your commandments.
bsb.119:74: May those who fear You see me and rejoice, for I have hoped in Your word.
bsb.119:75: I know, O LORD, that Your judgments are righteous, and that in faithfulness You have afflicted me.
bsb.119:76: May Your loving devotion comfort me, I pray, according to Your promise to Your servant.
bsb.119:77: May Your compassion come to me, that I may live, for Your law is my delight.
bsb.119:78: May the arrogant be put to shame for subverting me with a lie; I will meditate on Your precepts.
bsb.119:79: May those who fear You turn to me, those who know Your testimonies.
bsb.119:80: May my heart be blameless in Your statutes, that I may not be put to shame.
bsb.119:81: My soul faints for Your salvation; I wait for Your word.
bsb.119:82: My eyes fail, looking for Your promise; I ask, “When will You comfort me?”
bsb.119:83: Though I am like a wineskin dried up by smoke, I do not forget Your statutes.
bsb.119:84: How many days must Your servant wait? When will You execute judgment on my persecutors?
bsb.119:85: The arrogant have dug pits for me in violation of Your law.
bsb.119:86: All Your commandments are faithful; I am persecuted without cause—help me!
bsb.119:87: They almost wiped me from the earth, but I have not forsaken Your precepts.
bsb.119:88: Revive me according to Your loving devotion, that I may obey the testimony of Your mouth.
bsb.119:89: Your word, O LORD, is everlasting; it is firmly fixed in the heavens.
bsb.119:90: Your faithfulness continues through all generations; You established the earth, and it endures.
bsb.119:91: Your ordinances stand to this day, for all things are servants to You.
bsb.119:92: If Your law had not been my delight, then I would have perished in my affliction.
bsb.119:93: I will never forget Your precepts, for by them You have revived me.
bsb.119:94: I am Yours; save me, for I have sought Your precepts.
bsb.119:95: The wicked wait to destroy me, but I will ponder Your testimonies.
bsb.119:96: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but Your commandment is without limit.
bsb.119:97: Oh, how I love Your law! All day long it is my meditation.
bsb.119:98: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for they are always with me.
bsb.119:99: I have more insight than all my teachers, for Your testimonies are my meditation.
bsb.119:100: I discern more than the elders, for I obey Your precepts.
bsb.119:101: I have kept my feet from every evil path, that I may keep Your word.
bsb.119:102: I have not departed from Your ordinances, for You Yourself have taught me.
bsb.119:103: How sweet are Your words to my taste— sweeter than honey in my mouth!
bsb.119:104: I gain understanding from Your precepts; therefore I hate every false way.
bsb.119:105: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
bsb.119:106: I have sworn and confirmed that I will keep Your righteous judgments.
bsb.119:107: I am severely afflicted, O LORD; revive me through Your word.
bsb.119:108: Accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me Your judgments.
bsb.119:109: I constantly take my life in my hands, yet I do not forget Your law.
bsb.119:110: The wicked have set a snare for me, but I have not strayed from Your precepts.
bsb.119:111: Your testimonies are my heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
bsb.119:112: I have inclined my heart to perform Your statutes, even to the very end.
bsb.119:113: The double-minded I despise, but Your law I love.
bsb.119:114: You are my hiding place and my shield; I put my hope in Your word.
bsb.119:115: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may obey the commandments of my God.
bsb.119:116: Sustain me as You promised, that I may live; let me not be ashamed of my hope.
bsb.119:117: Uphold me, and I will be saved, that I may always regard Your statutes.
bsb.119:118: You reject all who stray from Your statutes, for their deceitfulness is in vain.
bsb.119:119: All the wicked on earth You discard like dross; therefore I love Your testimonies.
bsb.119:120: My flesh trembles in awe of You; I stand in fear of Your judgments.
bsb.119:121: I have done what is just and right; do not leave me to my oppressors.
bsb.119:122: Ensure Your servant’s well-being; do not let the arrogant oppress me.
bsb.119:123: My eyes fail, looking for Your salvation, and for Your righteous promise.
bsb.119:124: Deal with Your servant according to Your loving devotion, and teach me Your statutes.
bsb.119:125: I am Your servant; give me understanding, that I may know Your testimonies.
bsb.119:126: It is time for the LORD to act, for they have broken Your law.
bsb.119:127: Therefore I love Your commandments more than gold, even the purest gold.
bsb.119:128: Therefore I admire all Your precepts and hate every false way.
bsb.119:129: Wonderful are Your testimonies; therefore I obey them.
bsb.119:130: The unfolding of Your words gives light; it informs the simple.
bsb.119:131: I open my mouth and pant, longing for Your commandments.
bsb.119:132: Turn to me and show me mercy, as You do to those who love Your name.
bsb.119:133: Order my steps in Your word; let no sin rule over me.
bsb.119:134: Redeem me from the oppression of man, that I may keep Your precepts.
bsb.119:135: Make Your face shine upon Your servant, and teach me Your statutes.
bsb.119:136: My eyes shed streams of tears because Your law is not obeyed.
bsb.119:137: Righteous are You, O LORD, and upright are Your judgments.
bsb.119:138: The testimonies You have laid down are righteous and altogether faithful.
bsb.119:139: My zeal has consumed me because my foes forget Your words.
bsb.119:140: Your promise is completely pure; therefore Your servant loves it.
bsb.119:141: I am lowly and despised, but I do not forget Your precepts.
bsb.119:142: Your righteousness is everlasting and Your law is true.
bsb.119:143: Trouble and distress have found me, but Your commandments are my delight.
bsb.119:144: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live.
bsb.119:145: I call with all my heart; answer me, O LORD! I will obey Your statutes.
bsb.119:146: I call to You; save me, that I may keep Your testimonies.
bsb.119:147: I rise before dawn and cry for help; in Your word I have put my hope.
bsb.119:148: My eyes anticipate the watches of night, that I may meditate on Your word.
bsb.119:149: Hear my voice, O LORD, according to Your loving devotion; give me life according to Your justice.
bsb.119:150: Those who follow after wickedness draw near; they are far from Your law.
bsb.119:151: You are near, O LORD, and all Your commandments are true.
bsb.119:152: Long ago I learned from Your testimonies that You have established them forever.
bsb.119:153: Look upon my affliction and rescue me, for I have not forgotten Your law.
bsb.119:154: Defend my cause and redeem me; revive me according to Your word.
bsb.119:155: Salvation is far from the wicked because they do not seek Your statutes.
bsb.119:156: Great are Your mercies, O LORD; revive me according to Your ordinances.
bsb.119:157: Though my persecutors and foes are many, I have not turned from Your testimonies.
bsb.119:158: I look on the faithless with loathing because they do not keep Your word.
bsb.119:159: Consider how I love Your precepts, O LORD; give me life according to Your loving devotion.
bsb.119:160: The entirety of Your word is truth, and all Your righteous judgments endure forever.
bsb.119:161: Rulers persecute me without cause, but my heart fears only Your word.
bsb.119:162: I rejoice in Your promise like one who finds great spoil.
bsb.119:163: I hate and abhor falsehood, but Your law I love.
bsb.119:164: Seven times a day I praise You for Your righteous judgments.
bsb.119:165: Abundant peace belongs to those who love Your law; nothing can make them stumble.
bsb.119:166: I wait for Your salvation, O LORD, and I carry out Your commandments.
bsb.119:167: I obey Your testimonies and love them greatly.
bsb.119:168: I obey Your precepts and Your testimonies, for all my ways are before You.
bsb.119:169: May my cry come before You, O LORD; give me understanding according to Your word.
bsb.119:170: May my plea come before You; rescue me according to Your promise.
bsb.119:171: My lips pour forth praise, for You teach me Your statutes.
bsb.119:172: My tongue sings of Your word, for all Your commandments are righteous.
bsb.119:173: May Your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen Your precepts.
bsb.119:174: I long for Your salvation, O LORD, and Your law is my delight.
bsb.119:175: Let me live to praise You; may Your judgments sustain me.
bsb.119:176: I have strayed like a lost sheep; seek Your servant, for I have not forgotten Your commandments.
bsb.120:1: A song of ascents. In my distress I cried to the LORD, and He answered me.
bsb.120:2: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips and a deceitful tongue.
bsb.120:3: What will He do to you, and what will be added to you, O deceitful tongue?
bsb.120:4: Sharp arrows will come from the warrior, with burning coals of the broom tree!
bsb.120:5: Woe to me that I dwell in Meshech, that I live among the tents of Kedar!
bsb.120:6: Too long have I dwelt among those who hate peace.
bsb.120:7: I am in favor of peace; but when I speak, they want war.
bsb.121:1: A song of ascents. I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come?
bsb.121:2: My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
bsb.121:3: He will not allow your foot to slip; your Protector will not slumber.
bsb.121:4: Behold, the Protector of Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.
bsb.121:5: The LORD is your keeper; the LORD is the shade on your right hand.
bsb.121:6: The sun will not strike you by day, nor the moon by night.
bsb.121:7: The LORD will guard you from all evil; He will preserve your soul.
bsb.121:8: The LORD will watch over your coming and going, both now and forevermore.
bsb.122:1: A song of ascents. Of David. I was glad when they said to me, “Let us go to the house of the LORD.”
bsb.122:2: Our feet are standing in your gates, O Jerusalem.
bsb.122:3: Jerusalem is built up as a city united together,
bsb.122:4: where the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, as a testimony for Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD.
bsb.122:5: For there the thrones of judgment stand, the thrones of the house of David.
bsb.122:6: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: “May those who love you prosper.
bsb.122:7: May there be peace within your walls, and prosperity inside your fortresses.”
bsb.122:8: For the sake of my brothers and friends, I will say, “Peace be within you.”
bsb.122:9: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your prosperity.
bsb.123:1: A song of ascents. I lift up my eyes to You, the One enthroned in heaven.
bsb.123:2: As the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maidservant look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes are on the LORD our God until He shows us mercy.
bsb.123:3: Have mercy on us, O LORD, have mercy, for we have endured much contempt.
bsb.123:4: We have endured much scorn from the arrogant, much contempt from the proud.
bsb.124:1: A song of ascents. Of David. If the LORD had not been on our side— let Israel now declare—
bsb.124:2: if the LORD had not been on our side when men attacked us,
bsb.124:3: when their anger flared against us, then they would have swallowed us alive,
bsb.124:4: then the floods would have engulfed us, then the torrent would have overwhelmed us,
bsb.124:5: then the raging waters would have swept us away.
bsb.124:6: Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as prey to their teeth.
bsb.124:7: We have escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowler; the net is torn, and we have slipped away.
bsb.124:8: Our help is in the name of the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
bsb.125:1: A song of ascents. Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion. It cannot be moved; it abides forever.
bsb.125:2: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds His people, both now and forevermore.
bsb.125:3: For the scepter of the wicked will not rest upon the land allotted to the righteous, so that the righteous will not put forth their hands to injustice.
bsb.125:4: Do good, O LORD, to those who are good, and to the upright in heart.
bsb.125:5: But those who turn to crooked ways the LORD will banish with the evildoers. Peace be upon Israel.
bsb.126:1: A song of ascents. When the LORD restored the captives of Zion, we were like dreamers.
bsb.126:2: Then our mouths were filled with laughter, our tongues with shouts of joy. Then it was said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
bsb.126:3: The LORD has done great things for us; we are filled with joy.
bsb.126:4: Restore our captives, O LORD, like streams in the Negev.
bsb.126:5: Those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy.
bsb.126:6: He who goes out weeping, bearing a trail of seed, will surely return with shouts of joy, carrying sheaves of grain.
bsb.127:1: A song of ascents. Of Solomon. Unless the LORD builds the house, its builders labor in vain; unless the LORD protects the city, its watchmen stand guard in vain.
bsb.127:2: In vain you rise early and stay up late, toiling for bread to eat— for He gives sleep to His beloved.
bsb.127:3: Children are indeed a heritage from the LORD, and the fruit of the womb is His reward.
bsb.127:4: Like arrows in the hand of a warrior, so are children born in one’s youth.
bsb.127:5: Blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them. He will not be put to shame when he confronts the enemies at the gate.
bsb.128:1: A song of ascents. Blessed are all who fear the LORD, who walk in His ways!
bsb.128:2: For when you eat the fruit of your labor, blessings and prosperity will be yours.
bsb.128:3: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine flourishing within your house, your sons like olive shoots sitting around your table.
bsb.128:4: In this way indeed shall blessing come to the man who fears the LORD.
bsb.128:5: May the LORD bless you from Zion, that you may see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life,
bsb.128:6: that you may see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel!
bsb.129:1: A song of ascents. Many a time they have persecuted me from my youth— let Israel now declare—
bsb.129:2: many a time they have persecuted me from my youth, but they have not prevailed against me.
bsb.129:3: The plowmen plowed over my back; they made their furrows long.
bsb.129:4: The LORD is righteous; He has cut me from the cords of the wicked.
bsb.129:5: May all who hate Zion be turned back in shame.
bsb.129:6: May they be like grass on the rooftops, which withers before it can grow,
bsb.129:7: unable to fill the hands of the reaper, or the arms of the binder of sheaves.
bsb.129:8: May none who pass by say to them, “The blessing of the LORD be on you; we bless you in the name of the LORD.”
bsb.130:1: A song of ascents. Out of the depths I cry to You, O LORD!
bsb.130:2: O Lord, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.
bsb.130:3: If You, O LORD, kept track of iniquities, then who, O Lord, could stand?
bsb.130:4: But with You there is forgiveness, so that You may be feared.
bsb.130:5: I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait, and in His word I put my hope.
bsb.130:6: My soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning— more than watchmen wait for the morning.
bsb.130:7: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, for with the LORD is loving devotion, and with Him is redemption in abundance.
bsb.130:8: And He will redeem Israel from all iniquity.
bsb.131:1: A song of ascents. Of David. My heart is not proud, O LORD, my eyes are not haughty. I do not aspire to great things or matters too lofty for me.
bsb.131:2: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul; like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.
bsb.131:3: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, both now and forevermore.
bsb.132:1: A song of ascents. O LORD, remember on behalf of David all the hardships he endured,
bsb.132:2: how he swore an oath to the LORD, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:
bsb.132:3: “I will not enter my house or get into my bed,
bsb.132:4: I will not give sleep to my eyes or slumber to my eyelids,
bsb.132:5: until I find a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”
bsb.132:6: We heard that the ark was in Ephrathah; we found it in the fields of Jaar.
bsb.132:7: Let us go to His dwelling place; let us worship at His footstool.
bsb.132:8: Arise, O LORD, to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your strength.
bsb.132:9: May Your priests be clothed with righteousness, and Your saints shout for joy.
bsb.132:10: For the sake of Your servant David, do not reject Your anointed one.
bsb.132:11: The LORD swore an oath to David, a promise He will not revoke: “One of your descendants I will place on your throne.
bsb.132:12: If your sons keep My covenant and the testimony I will teach them, then their sons will also sit on your throne forever and ever.”
bsb.132:13: For the LORD has chosen Zion; He has desired it for His home:
bsb.132:14: “This is My resting place forever and ever; here I will dwell, for I have desired this home.
bsb.132:15: I will bless her with abundant provisions; I will satisfy her poor with bread.
bsb.132:16: I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her saints will sing out in joy.
bsb.132:17: There I will make a horn grow for David; I have prepared a lamp for My anointed one.
bsb.132:18: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but the crown upon him will gleam.”
bsb.133:1: A song of ascents. Of David. Behold, how good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony!
bsb.133:2: It is like fine oil on the head, running down on the beard, running down Aaron’s beard over the collar of his robes.
bsb.133:3: It is like the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion. For there the LORD has bestowed the blessing of life forevermore.
bsb.134:1: A song of ascents. Come, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD who serve by night in the house of the LORD!
bsb.134:2: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary and bless the LORD!
bsb.134:3: May the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.
bsb.135:1: Hallelujah! Praise the name of the LORD. Give praise, O servants of the LORD,
bsb.135:2: who stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God.
bsb.135:3: Hallelujah, for the LORD is good; sing praises to His name, for it is lovely.
bsb.135:4: For the LORD has chosen Jacob as His own, Israel as His treasured possession.
bsb.135:5: For I know that the LORD is great; our Lord is above all gods.
bsb.135:6: The LORD does all that pleases Him in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and in all their depths.
bsb.135:7: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.
bsb.135:8: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, of both man and beast.
bsb.135:9: He sent signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.
bsb.135:10: He struck down many nations and slaughtered mighty kings:
bsb.135:11: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kings of Canaan.
bsb.135:12: He gave their land as an inheritance, as a heritage to His people Israel.
bsb.135:13: Your name, O LORD, endures forever, Your renown, O LORD, through all generations.
bsb.135:14: For the LORD will vindicate His people and will have compassion on His servants.
bsb.135:15: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.
bsb.135:16: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;
bsb.135:17: they have ears, but cannot hear; nor is there breath in their mouths.
bsb.135:18: Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.
bsb.135:19: O house of Israel, bless the LORD; O house of Aaron, bless the LORD;
bsb.135:20: O house of Levi, bless the LORD; you who fear the LORD, bless the LORD!
bsb.135:21: Blessed be the LORD from Zion— He who dwells in Jerusalem. Hallelujah!
bsb.136:1: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good. His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.136:2: Give thanks to the God of gods. His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.136:3: Give thanks to the Lord of lords. His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.136:4: He alone does great wonders. His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.136:5: By His insight He made the heavens. His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.136:6: He spread out the earth upon the waters. His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.136:7: He made the great lights— His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.136:8: the sun to rule the day, His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.136:9: the moon and stars to govern the night. His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.136:10: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.136:11: and brought Israel out from among them His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.136:12: with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.136:13: He divided the Red Sea in two His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.136:14: and led Israel through the midst, His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.136:15: but swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea. His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.136:16: He led His people through the wilderness. His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.136:17: He struck down great kings His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.136:18: and slaughtered mighty kings— His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.136:19: Sihon king of the Amorites His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.136:20: and Og king of Bashan— His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.136:21: and He gave their land as an inheritance, His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.136:22: a heritage to His servant Israel. His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.136:23: He remembered us in our low estate His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.136:24: and freed us from our enemies. His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.136:25: He gives food to every creature. His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.136:26: Give thanks to the God of heaven! His loving devotion endures forever.
bsb.137:1: By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept when we remembered Zion.
bsb.137:2: There on the willows we hung our harps,
bsb.137:3: for there our captors requested a song; our tormentors demanded songs of joy: “Sing us a song of Zion.”
bsb.137:4: How can we sing a song of the LORD in a foreign land?
bsb.137:5: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, may my right hand cease to function.
bsb.137:6: May my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember you, if I do not exalt Jerusalem as my greatest joy!
bsb.137:7: Remember, O LORD, the sons of Edom on the day Jerusalem fell: “Destroy it,” they said, “tear it down to its foundations!”
bsb.137:8: O Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, blessed is he who repays you as you have done to us.
bsb.137:9: Blessed is he who seizes your infants and dashes them against the rocks.
bsb.138:1: Of David. I give You thanks with all my heart; before the gods I sing Your praises.
bsb.138:2: I bow down toward Your holy temple and give thanks to Your name for Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness; You have exalted Your name and Your word above all else.
bsb.138:3: On the day I called, You answered me; You emboldened me and strengthened my soul.
bsb.138:4: All the kings of the earth will give You thanks, O LORD, when they hear the words of Your mouth.
bsb.138:5: They will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the glory of the LORD is great.
bsb.138:6: Though the LORD is on high, He attends to the lowly; but the proud He knows from afar.
bsb.138:7: If I walk in the midst of trouble, You preserve me from the anger of my foes; You extend Your hand, and Your right hand saves me.
bsb.138:8: The LORD will fulfill His purpose for me. O LORD, Your loving devotion endures forever— do not abandon the works of Your hands.
bsb.139:1: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O LORD, You have searched me and known me.
bsb.139:2: You know when I sit and when I rise; You understand my thoughts from afar.
bsb.139:3: You search out my path and my lying down; You are aware of all my ways.
bsb.139:4: Even before a word is on my tongue, You know all about it, O LORD.
bsb.139:5: You hem me in behind and before; You have laid Your hand upon me.
bsb.139:6: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me, too lofty for me to attain.
bsb.139:7: Where can I go to escape Your Spirit? Where can I flee from Your presence?
bsb.139:8: If I ascend to the heavens, You are there; if I make my bed in Sheol, You are there.
bsb.139:9: If I rise on the wings of the dawn, if I settle by the farthest sea,
bsb.139:10: even there Your hand will guide me; Your right hand will hold me fast.
bsb.139:11: If I say, “Surely the darkness will hide me, and the light become night around me”—
bsb.139:12: even the darkness is not dark to You, but the night shines like the day, for darkness is as light to You.
bsb.139:13: For You formed my inmost being; You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
bsb.139:14: I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well.
bsb.139:15: My frame was not hidden from You when I was made in secret, when I was woven together in the depths of the earth.
bsb.139:16: Your eyes saw my unformed body; all my days were written in Your book and ordained for me before one of them came to be.
bsb.139:17: How precious to me are Your thoughts, O God, how vast is their sum!
bsb.139:18: If I were to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand; and when I awake, I am still with You.
bsb.139:19: O God, that You would slay the wicked— away from me, you bloodthirsty men—
bsb.139:20: who speak of You deceitfully; Your enemies take Your name in vain.
bsb.139:21: Do I not hate those who hate You, O LORD, and detest those who rise against You?
bsb.139:22: I hate them with perfect hatred; I count them as my enemies.
bsb.139:23: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my concerns.
bsb.139:24: See if there is any offensive way in me; lead me in the way everlasting.
bsb.140:1: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Rescue me, O LORD, from evil men. Protect me from men of violence,
bsb.140:2: who devise evil in their hearts and stir up war all day long.
bsb.140:3: They sharpen their tongues like snakes; the venom of vipers is on their lips. Selah
bsb.140:4: Guard me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked. Keep me safe from men of violence who scheme to make me stumble.
bsb.140:5: The proud hide a snare for me; the cords of their net are spread along the path, and lures are set out for me. Selah
